purpose: Create a directly identified domestic-individual market-participation baseline for falsifying retail proxies without pretending it is stock-level directional flow.

directOfficialSource.family: 集中市場成交值投資人類別比例表
directOfficialSource.evidence: Official historical TWSE statistical publications expose monthly/yearly amount and percentage by investor class.

supportingDirectChannels.evidence: TWSE 2026 market-structure analysis reports domestic individuals account for more than 98% of margin trading as of end-July 2026.
supportingDirectChannels.guard: Does not convert margin financing into direct retail flow.

supportingDirectChannels.evidence: TWSE market-insights statistics directly report domestic-individual share of odd-lot trading value.
supportingDirectChannels.guard: Does not generalize odd-lot participation to all retail trading.

thresholdGuard: Do not optimize or assign fixed high/low cutoffs before preregistered distributional analysis. States are descriptive until validated.

proxyValidationPlan.goal: Measure how well common Taiwan retail proxies track directly identified aggregate natural-person participation.
candidateProxies: day-trading market participation where investor-class semantics permit
broker-branch aggregates only as execution context, never identity
proxyValidationPlan.outcomes: CLOSED; no return join in proxy-validation stage

forbidden: market-level retail share -> stock-level retail buy/sell/net
annual/monthly retail share -> daily stock feature without explicit temporal hold rule
total market minus institutions -> direct retail net flow
fixed bullish/bearish interpretation of high retail participation

l3Boundary.aggregateSublane: PIT/REPLAY FEASIBLE AT HISTORICAL AGGREGATE LEVEL
l3Boundary.wholeModule: L2 remains because core stock-date directional direct-retail source is restricted-access gated and current authorized PIT contract is unverified.

exactNext: Build outcome-blind aligned aggregate receipts when publication generations are captured; compare margin/odd-lot/day-trade proxies against direct market-level individual participation at common frequency. No stock-level inference and no maturity promotion from aggregate replay alone.
